name: Route all on-screen game text through the bottom-right box
body: Only the help line (signs, F: climb) sits in the small bottom-right box. Every other in-game line (rules.Announce and ShowMessage: partner notes, words collected, checkpoint, seen, lantern, and the Finding Her prototypes' notes) still draws centred at 30% of the screen height, as does the photo viewfinder's hint. Route them all through the one box. Full-screen text stays centred: main menu, pause menu and the level complete card.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-21 before any code, from Dean: most text is still in the middle of the screen instead of the bottom-right box. Audit: the centred sources are GameUiModel.message (hud.chaos hud-middle) and PhotoHud's viewfinder-hint. Finding Her (PR #215) notes go through rules.Announce, so they follow the same path. Its ending line (rules.Announce(ending, 6.0f)) is an ending card and needs AnnounceCard once #215 is merged.

acceptance_criteria: Announcements and rule messages appear in the bottom-right box
The photo viewfinder's line appears in the box
The main menu, pause menu and level complete card stay centred
